description: This Java class defines Swagger API resource documentation models for delinquency-related API responses in the Fineract project, including response schemas for delinquency ranges, buckets, tags, actions, and requests.

classes.name: DelinquencyApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes defining response and request schemas for API endpoints related to delinquency management.

classes.name: PostDelinquencyRangeResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a delinquency range, contains resourceId.

classes.name: PutDelinquencyRangeResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a delinquency range, contains resourceId and changes.

classes.name: DeleteDelinquencyRangeResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a delinquency range, contains resourceId.

classes.name: PostDelinquencyBucketResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a delinquency bucket, contains resourceId.

classes.name: PutDelinquencyBucketResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a delinquency bucket, contains resourceId.

classes.name: DeleteDelinquencyBucketResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a delinquency bucket, contains resourceId.

classes.name: GetDelinquencyTagHistoryResponse
classes.description: Schema for delinquency tag history retrieval, contains id, loanId, delinquencyRange, addedOnDate, liftedOnDate.

classes.name: GetDelinquencyActionsResponse
classes.description: Schema for actions taken on delinquencies, includes id, action, start/end dates, createdById, createdOn, updatedById, lastModifiedOn.

classes.name: PostLoansDelinquencyActionRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to post a delinquency action, includes action type, start/end dates, dateFormat, locale.

classes.name: PostLoansDelinquencyActionResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after posting a delinquency action, includes officeId, clientId, resourceId.
